title: A few things fall into place
description: A small group of related items arrives in a short, measured stagger.
useCase: Introduce a compact group of newly loaded or newly created items without delaying interaction.
reducedMotion: All items are immediately visible without stagger, travel or blur.
limitations: A short three-item entrance. Avoid repeating stagger animations on large lists or frequently used navigation.
look: Warm off-white page with a small uppercase header over three cream rounded list cards, each holding a muted sage, tan or lilac shape and arrow.
motion: On mount the three cards rise 12 px, fade in and unblur from 3 px, staggered 65 ms apart, each over 350 ms with an ease-out-quart curve.
adapt: A `motion.ul` with `staggerChildren` (0.065 s) runs each `motion.li` through `variants` from `hidden` (`opacity` 0, `y` 12, `filter` blur 3 px) to `visible`; tune stagger, `duration` and `ease`. Replace `ideas`; changing the `key` replays it.
